This is my rented plot for tubers—likely cassava or yam, the crops we grow here in the South East. I will apply some bags of NPK 20-10-10 because the soil on this land is not as fertile as it used to be, but I cannot afford too much since I must pay rent for this plot and money is tight this season. I will plant with local cuttings and setts from my own harvest, not those improved ones, because they are cheaper and I know they do well here. For labor, my family and I will handle the planting and weeding, but I will need to hire a few extra hands when it is time for the heavy work of mounding and harvesting.
